objects.note_en: A dense blue-violet stroke sits beside a bright white-and-gold flower, the two left uncompromised rather than blended.

objects.note_en: A single dark green leaf-stroke is placed flatly over a field of pink, yellow and white gestures, interrupting the surface beneath it.

objects.note_en: Concentric pink and white strokes build the rose's form; direction and rhythm follow the flower's own spiral structure.
objects.author: nona

objects.note_en: Magenta and violet petals emerge from near-black shadow, the contrast of light and dark carrying the flower's structure.
objects.author: nona

objects.note_en: Gold, orange and violet strokes cross at odd angles, each colour remaining distinct rather than resolving into a single tone.
